:[A television is showing Miss Lenhart as a news anchor. The inset picture of the news shows the logo of LulzSec, a man wearing a monocle and top hat.]
:Miss Lenhart: Hackers briefly took down the website of the CIA yesterday...

:[Ponytail, sitting in an armchair, is watching a television  (seen from the side) standing on a table hearing what Miss Lenhart says as indicated with a zigzag line from the TV. Above the top part of the frame is a smaller frame with a label:]
:What people hear:
:Miss Lenhart (not shown from the TV): Someone hacked into the computers of the '''''CIA!!'''''

:[Megan, sitting in an armchair, is watching a television (seen from the side) standing on a table hearing what Miss Lenhart says as indicated with a zigzag line from the TV. Above the top part of the frame is a smaller frame with a label:]
:What computer experts hear:
:Miss Lenhart (not shown from the TV): Someone tore down a poster hung up by the '''''CIA!!'''''
